parts.name: Switch_1
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the four toggle switches on the switch panel, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a lever to open or close an electrical circuit, controlling a connected device.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or linearly within its slot to toggle between ON and OFF positions.

parts.name: Switch_2
parts.Basic_description: This is the second toggle switch on the panel, made of plastic and identical in shape to the others.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit or function within the same system.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or slides within its slot to change the circuit state.

parts.name: Switch_3
parts.Basic_description: This is the third toggle switch on the switch panel, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides manual control for another circuit or device connected to the panel.
parts.Movement_description: It moves back and forth within its slot to toggle the circuit state.

parts.name: Switch_4
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth toggle switch on the switch panel, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as a control lever for an independent electrical function.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly or rotationally within its slot to switch between ON and OFF.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the switch panel, made of rigid plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the switches securely in place.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
